excludedClaims: Next-token pretraining always produces the most probable continuation, and RLHF fully closes an alignment gap or guarantees helpful, truthful and harmless behavior.
The two archival comparison totals are interchangeable facts. InstructGPT Table 6 counts prompts, not independent pairs; K and dropped ties are needed to recover the number of comparisons.
SFT is always the best RM initialization. InstructGPT Appendix C.2 reports a public-NLP-finetuned GPT-3 initialization and similar results from GPT-3/SFT initializations.
Reward models are necessarily trained once for an entire project, or frozen evaluation within one optimization round precludes collecting new comparisons and retraining between rounds.
A KL penalty or PPO clipping guarantees protection against reward hacking, or PPO-ptx universally eliminates regressions.
Functional roles imply four equally sized, simultaneously resident models; RM size ratios prove a universal policy-to-RM sizing rule or better quality.
RLAIF is a competing optimizer in the same category as PPO/DPO, Constitutional AI removes learned reward models, or GRPO inherently requires or excludes a learned reward model.
DPO is unconditionally mathematically equivalent to an actual PPO training run; an implicit reward expression has a unique absolute prompt-independent origin.
RLVR always uses a binary, infallible correctness reward; arbitrary factual QA has a deterministic complete verifier.
An archive trend list establishes universal superiority, stability, adoption or a complete description of all later commercial model training recipes.

Unscoped toxicity/hallucination percentages or parameter-size comparisons establish general capability dominance. Historical comparisons require their prompt distribution, baselines and evaluation protocol.
historicalMaterialDisposition: Archival files remain byte-for-byte intact, including their source links and illustrations. Historical hyperparameter/size/result lists are not promoted to universal textbook rules, and are not counted as an additional mechanism. The linked primary reports remain available for the exact experimental recipes. This acceptance is migration of these two conceptual notes, not acceptance of every named model release, every benchmark number or every later method.
